title: Release Notes → GTM Playbook and Beta Feedback Ops
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Prepare and coordinate all release-notes, GTM collateral, and feedback operations for the upcoming beta -> lighthouse cohort transition. This ticket centralizes the public-facing change log, internal TL;DRs for Sales/CS/Support, and a defined feedback ingestion + prioritization loop so we can close the loop with customers within agreed SLAs. Scope includes: release notes draft, segmented distribution plan (internal -> beta cohort -> lighthouse accounts -> public), dedicated feedback channels, weekly synthesis digest, prioritized bug triage for P0/P1 regressions, and success criteria for promoting the feature out of beta. Out of scope: changes to pricing or legal contracts (handled by Legal/Finance); platform SDK backward-incompatible changes (handled via separate deprecation RFC).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical release notes published to docs site and linked in single source-of-truth (Confluence + docs.redwood) before beta email goes out
Sales/CS enablement pack (one-pager + 3 demo scripts + objection handling) delivered 3 business days before lighthouse invites
Feedback ingestion channel(s) configured: dedicated Slack channel, Jira/Linear tag mapping, and nightly feedback digest to PM/ENG/CS
At least 3 lighthouse accounts signed up and briefed; 2 have acceptance tests and SLO expectations documented
No P0 regressions outstanding at the time of public release; any P1s must have documented mitigation and timeline
